title: Bored Hearts :|
description: the hearts are bored, thats just it. The update is OUT! Now ALL of the Hearts are textured!
body: the hearts are bored of just sitting there doing nothing, other than telling you that you're almost dead. if you couldn't tell by the icon, the hearts are just bored, their faces are just bored, yeah.
